Name: Beacon Stone
Author: undare
Description:
Some people are throwing some valuable stones away in the valley (Around [b]75[color=#ffd966]g[/color][/b] really.)

If the farmer happens to [b][color=#6d9eeb][size=3]HOLD IT[/size][/color][/b] above their head, they might get a new [b]QUEST[color=#ffe599]*[/color][/b], delivered through a... godly voice?.

[b][color=#ffe599]*[/color][/b]This quest [b][color=#f6b26b]cannot be completed on the valley[/color][/b], and it [b][color=#93c47d]will repeat[/color][/b] at least [b][color=#ffd966]Once per day[/color][/b] every time you [b]touch the Stone.[/b]
On the other hand, you could sell the stone or collect it.


You can find this stone by:
-Fishing treasure chests
-Gold Panning
-Train drops
and
-Monster drops

The drop rate in average is around 4% (Quite rare in the long run.)
This is how they get you!, you think you haven't seen the stone in many days.. and while you are cheking your inventory, BOOM!. That voice again!.




--------------------------
Note : the "[b]Quest[/b]" is just verbally stated. There is no quest entry or consecuence if you decide to ignore it.
[b][i][color=#c27ba0]Some [/color][/i][/b]people even try to avoid touching the stone.

-First release.
You find the stone, you touch or ignore it. = Profit!
